import ctypes

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function
def set_ieee_mode(precision, rounding, exception_mask):
    return gsl.gsl_ieee_set_mode(precision, rounding, exception_mask)

# Test cases
def assert_test():
    GSL_SUCCESS = 0
    GSL_IEEE_SINGLE_PRECISION = 0
    GSL_IEEE_DOUBLE_PRECISION = 1
    GSL_IEEE_EXTENDED_PRECISION = 2
    GSL_IEEE_ROUND_TO_NEAREST = 0
    GSL_IEEE_ROUND_DOWN = 1
    GSL_IEEE_ROUND_UP = 2
    GSL_IEEE_ROUND_TO_ZERO = 3
    GSL_IEEE_MASK_INVALID = 1 << 0
    GSL_IEEE_MASK_DENORMALIZED = 1 << 1
    GSL_IEEE_MASK_DIVISION_BY_ZERO = 1 << 2
    GSL_IEEE_MASK_OVERFLOW = 1 << 3
    GSL_IEEE_MASK_UNDERFLOW = 1 << 4
    GSL_IEEE_TRAP_INEXACT = 1 << 5

    # Test single precision, round to nearest, no exception mask
    assert set_ieee_mode(GSL_IEEE_SINGLE_PRECISION, GSL_IEEE_ROUND_TO_NEAREST, 0) == GSL_SUCCESS
    
    # Test double precision, round down, mask invalid exception
    assert set_ieee_mode(GSL_IEEE_DOUBLE_PRECISION, GSL_IEEE_ROUND_DOWN, GSL_IEEE_MASK_INVALID) == GSL_SUCCESS
    
    # Test extended precision, round up, mask division by zero
    assert set_ieee_mode(GSL_IEEE_EXTENDED_PRECISION, GSL_IEEE_ROUND_UP, GSL_IEEE_MASK_DIVISION_BY_ZERO) == GSL_SUCCESS
    
    # Test single precision, round to zero, mask overflow and underflow
    assert set_ieee_mode(GSL_IEEE_SINGLE_PRECISION, GSL_IEEE_ROUND_TO_ZERO, GSL_IEEE_MASK_OVERFLOW | GSL_IEEE_MASK_UNDERFLOW) == GSL_SUCCESS

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
